fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company expects to consume approximately 1.8 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2014.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company primarily uses a mixture of purchased call options, collar structures (purchased call + sold put), call spreads (purchased call + sold call), and fixed price swap agreements. Fair value table shows Swap contracts and Option contracts as distinct line items.

warnings: pct_hedged_current_year (51%) refers to FY2013 settled hedges per Note 10 language: 'For 2013, the Company had fuel derivative instruments in place for 51 percent of its fuel consumption.'
pct_hedged_next_year (43%) refers to 2014 hedges as of December 31, 2013 per Note 10: 'coverage for 43 percent of its 2014 estimated fuel consumption'.
WTI crude oil derivatives no longer qualify for hedge accounting as of 2013; changes in fair value of WTI derivatives recorded directly to earnings.
Hedge volumes are on an economic basis; Note states volumes may vary significantly as market prices fluctuate.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel and oil expense table: average cost $5,823 million, average cost per gallon $3.19 (Item 1, 2018 10-K filing, restated)
